verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents attaching images, screenshots, or marked-up mockups to a task or prompt, or the agent interpreting visual input to make UI changes. The Figma integration listing is a related but different feature, and it gives no detail on the agent consuming design visuals, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup to a task so the agent implements the correct visual change
